people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd, and touched his clothes.
translations.bsb: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
translations.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
translations.asv: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came in the crowd behind, and touched his garment.
